Wayanad Landslide Kills Five, Injures Seven Near Tunnel Project

A significant landslide occurred in Wayanad, Kerala, near a tunnel project, resulting in at least five deaths and seven injuries. Several individuals remain missing following the incident. Reports indicate that the disaster may have been man-made, with some outlets highlighting the collapse of a tunnel project slope. Rescue operations are underway, and officials are assessing the situation.
